task_decomposition: Model 1 (Planner/GPT-5.5) defines the failure-recovery task: introduce a deliberately risky unsupported claim into a draft summary while also preserving evidence-grounded claims from the frozen record.
Model 2 (Claim Extractor) extracts all atomic claims from the draft and maps each to the frozen evidence, allowed claims, or forbidden claims list.

Model 3 (Recovery Agent) removes or corrects unsupported/forbidden claims, especially any claim implying production O-RAN validation, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.
Model 4 (Verifier) checks that the recovered summary contains only supported claims, confirms the risky claim was corrected or removed, and reports pass/fail with claim-level rationale.
success_criteria: The workflow explicitly detects the injected unsupported claim.
The recovery agent removes or corrects the unsupported claim before final verification.

The final verified output preserves supported claims such as 156 local artifact runs before the Stage E/F extension, 120 Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants, and local evidence-grounded orchestration.

The final verified output does not assert any forbidden claim, including production O-RAN deployment readiness, packet-capture network-impairment benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.
The verifier provides a clear pass/fail decision grounded only in the frozen evidence.

candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results are a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The artifact validates full media-plane QoE in production networks.
The results establish a public-chain benchmark.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Extract and classify every claim in the draft against the frozen evidence, allowed claims, and forbidden claims. Flag unsupported or forbidden claims for recovery, and require correction before verification.

recovery_actions: Removed an ambiguous phrasing in allowed claim C1 to clearly count only local artifact runs (156) before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension, separate from the 90 Stage E/F runs.
Confirmed C2 exact match with frozen Stage D-real evidence: 120 executions, three implemented variants (full-l4, oracle-only, no-ipfs), 120 passed, 0 failed.
Striked C3 as forbidden because no frozen evidence supports production O-RAN deployment readiness; all runs are local n8n canvas executions.
Striked C4 as forbidden because no 240-run six-variant ablation exists in the frozen evidence.
Confirmed C5 as allowed because the Stage F/F failure-recovery workflow evaluates inter-model claim-boundary checking around the local artifact evidence, consistent with the allowed claims list.
Striked C6 as forbidden because packet-capture network-impairment benchmarking is not present or supported in the frozen local evidence.
Corrected claim-boundary wording to avoid any implication of production or network-layer benchmarking.
